understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and game to register a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced by 3 pixels. Selectable pieces could be switched with CLICK at their displayed positions. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed while moving, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though blocked hints were heuristic and actions sometimes needed to be tested. All pieces and goals had to be positioned correctly at the same time.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when multiple goals existed, all had to be occupied simultaneously for the level and game to register a win.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action using pixel coordinates spaced by 3 pixels. Selectable pieces could be switched with CLICK at their displayed positions. Adjacent pushable blocks could be pushed while moving, while walls and boundaries generally blocked movement, though blocked hints were heuristic and actions sometimes needed to be tested. All pieces and goals had to be positioned correctly at the same time.
